text:
Maria (Sales): FYI - TrinityBio POC is moving to procurement. They want split invoices across 3 entities: TrinityBio Inc (US), TrinityBio EU SARL (FR), TrinityLab UK Ltd. They also want EU VAT handling (reverse charge) and separate PO numbers per entity. Procurement also attached a DPA redline demanding HSM for hosted env and 72-hour breach notification. Can we support?

procurement_trinity: Hi team - thanks. We'd prefer HSM-backed key custody for all environments and a 72-hour breach notice in the DPA. Also need separate signers for each legal entity (could be AP delegation). Can you confirm billing flow?

Ben (Legal): HSM ask for hosted is an enterprise escalation. Our standard: HSM available for Private deployments only. For Hosted we can provide KMS attestation + SOC2 reports. On breach notice: 72 hours is aggressive; ops/legal have concerns about triage windows and customer notifications. We'll propose a 72-hour detection+72-hour notification compromise (i.e., reasonable efforts to notify within 72h after confirmation). Also need to check indemnity/cap language in the OF.

Kai (Solutions Eng): Technically, we can support per-entity metadata and route invoices. We'll add these fields on the OF payload: 
```
billing_entity: trinity-eu-sarl
po_number: TB-EU-2026-01
vat_number: FR12345678901
signer: "Elena Ruiz <elena@trinitybio.fr>"
```
Fallback: if signer field empty, route to parent finance alias.

Olivia (Finance): If invoices split across legal entities, we need tax IDs/EORI and explicit mapping before first invoice. EU reverse-charge: we require customer VAT validation. Net terms: procurement asked net30; we can do net30 after credit check. For POC we generally require a credit hold or CC on file if split entities are unvetted.

Maria (Sales): I'll push procurement for tax IDs and clarifying whether signers are legal counsels or AP delegates. Procurement said they prefer AP delegates for speed.

Jeremy (Security): HSM requirement: we can provide key attestation for hosted and an HSM option for Private or Dedicated. If they insist HSM for hosted, that's a product-level exception and will add cost. Also procurement asked for pen-test report and KMS architecture diagram. I can attach our KMS whitepaper and last pen-test summary.

Ben (Legal): About the DPA deletion SLA: they want 30 days. Our infra retention means 90 days minimum for backups. Counter: 90 days + documented purge process. Also flag: their redline tries to pin availability obligations to us; we must keep standard SLA carve-outs.

contracts-bot: Uploaded: Trinity_DPA_redline_v1.pdf (link)

procurement_trinity: Thanks. Quick Q: for PO signers, we can provide AP contacts and they can sign. Will that suffice? Also, do invoices need to be separate PDFs per entity or is a combined invoice with entity breakdown ok?

Olivia (Finance): Separate PDF invoices required for separate legal entities. Combined invoice complicates tax reporting. Also send remit-to addresses per entity.

Kai (Solutions Eng): I'll draft a sample OF JSON and sample invoice PDF schema this afternoon and post here. Example mapping: 
```
order_form_id: OF-2026-TB-01
line_items: [{sku: "poc-seat", qty: 1, price_usd: 0}]
invoice_entities: [{entity_id: "trinity-us", invoice_id: INV-TRI-US-001}, {entity_id: "trinity-eu", invoice_id: INV-TRI-EU-001}]
```

Ben (Legal): Also confirm signer attestation language. We'll add a short attestation clause: "Signatory represents they have authority to bind the listed legal entity." That should handle AP delegates.

Maria (Sales): Procurement - can you confirm tax IDs + remit addresses and whether AP delegates will sign? If they can sign, ask them to include role/title and a quick attestation email.

procurement_trinity: We'll collect tax IDs and remit addresses. AP can sign; we'll get the attestation. One more thing: they want liability cap = total fees paid in 12 months. Is that acceptable?

Ben (Legal): Liability cap tied to fees is standard, but for POC we may need a minimal floor. We'll propose cap = fees paid in previous 12 months or $250k, whichever is greater.

Jeremy (Security): I'll attach the diagram + pen-test excerpt. Also flag: if they request key export policies, clarify we don't support key export for hosted KMS. Private deployments can manage keys themselves.

Maria (Sales): Great. I'll collect the documents from procurement and post the redlines + tax IDs here by EOD. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
